content:
t1 (BS-1) completed.

Artifact: `.scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md` (461 lines, 43 KB).

The tracker locks the spec for downstream t2–t6:
- CONTEXT.md 10 invariants cited verbatim with operational mappings.
- All 14 LifecycleState values covered (transitions, owners, page surfaces).
- SQLite dev switch plan preserves canonical-model invariants; `WISPAY_DB_URL` wins over `AZURE_SQL_*`; `RuntimeError` at lifespan when neither is set.
- A1–A14 acceptance criteria mapped to services, repository contracts, pages, and tests.
- 7 prototype PRD OPEN questions resolved (Reflex-only; ADR-0006 labels; reference_data matrix; seed_rules_v1 thresholds; 30-day warning; brand-mark.svg; no bulk actions beyond scoped CSV).

One environment note surfaced (not silently fixed): AGENTS.md references `C:\Users\binh.phung\projects\WisPay-Design-System`; on this machine the design source is at `E:\projects\WisPay-deisgn` (directory name misspelled). Content matches the checked-in DESIGN.md snapshot.

Ready for the next task assignment.

t2 (BE-1) completed.

The dual-driver stores are wired behind the existing Stores Protocol; Azure SQL remains production, SQLite is the dev default with no Azure creds needed.

**Files changed (13):**
- pyproject.toml — pyodbc + msal moved to optional extras (azure, entra)
- WisPay/services/db.py — driver dispatch (default_db_url, driver_kind, sqlite_connect, sqlite_connect_in_memory, stores)
- WisPay/services/sqlite_repositories.py — NEW; SqliteRequestStore / SqliteWorkflowStore / SqliteAuditEventStore / SqliteRuleStore / sqlite_stores; reuses canonical parameter builders
- WisPay/services/runtime.py — caches either driver; reconnect probe handles both connection types; module-level _sql_stores / _sqlite_stores for monkeypatch
- rxconfig.py — WS_DB_URL first, then Azure SQL env, then sqlite:///wispay.db
- .env.example — documents WS_DB_URL precedence
- scripts/sql/schema.sqlite.sql — NEW; mirrors dbo.wispay_* tables
- scripts/validate.sh — defaults WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///./.wispay-validate.db; falls back to .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m when uv missing
- tests/services/test_db_sqlite.py — NEW; 8 tests
- tests/services/test_sqlite_repositories.py — NEW; 11 tests (request/workflow/audit/rule round-trip, hash chain, money precision)
- tests/services/test_runtime.py — patches module-level symbols; SQLite reconnect probe
- tests/services/test_db.py — clears WS_DB_URL so Azure tests stay on Azure path
- .scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md — §11 added

**Verification (per the contract):**
- WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///test.db + no Azure env → bash scripts/validate.sh → 203 passed, 9 deselected (e2e); ruff + mypy + format all pass.
- Same result with the validate.sh default WS_DB_URL.

**Driver precedence locked:**
1. WS_DB_URL (canonical knob; sqlite:/// and mssql+pyodbc:// accepted)
2. AZURE_SQL_{SERVER,DATABASE} populated → assemble Azure SQL URL
3. Otherwise → sqlite:///wispay.db

Ready for the next task.

UI-1 (t4) is complete and marked completed in the task list. Summary of what I built:

- 10 new reusable components under WisPay/components/: cards, status_pill, banner, lifecycle_stepper, tabs, table, empty_state, toast, waveform_amount_strip, navigation/mobile_bar — all re-exported from WisPay/components/__init__.py
- 6 new product surfaces: finance-review, payments, admin, audit, reports, plus refreshed dashboard
- 6 new routes wired in WisPay/routers.py + pages/__init__.py (/finance-review, /payments, /admin, /audit, /reports)
- 17 routes total — covers all 11 product surfaces per DESIGN.md
- assets/layout.css grew ~700 lines with the matching .wispay-* primitives (banners, tabs, mobile cards, KPI tiles, persona cards, audit/reports rows, admin threshold matrix); all sourced from --ws-* tokens, no ad-hoc values
- WisPay/styles.py: added Tokens.WAVE_BAR_* for the waveform strip

Quality gates all green:
- 203 pytest passing (174 baseline + 23 new component tests + 6 new page smoke tests)
- ruff check + ruff format check clean across WisPay/, tests/, scripts/
- mypy clean on all t4 paths
- A12 money-movement copy contract guarded by test_payments_renders_records_not_movement_copy
- No fabricated metrics — every number labeled "Sample configuration" or "Sample metrics"
- Responsive breakpoints honored: sidebar → drawer at 1024, table → mobile cards at 768, headers stack at 768

Out of scope for t4 (deliberately deferred):
- Live state binding on the new pages — composition only; t5 (integrations-engineer) wires services → states → handlers
- SQLite store wiring — owned by t2 (backend-engineer)
- e2e / Playwright review — owned by t6 (REL-1)

The new pages are ready for t5 to swap the fixture lists for live state projections. Ready for downstream work to begin.

t3 (BE-2) completed.

All services from the t3 contract (request_creation, request_query, approval_workflow, audit_trail, workflow_rules, reference_data, user_context, authentication) are wired to the new Stores Protocol and run against both FakeStores and SqliteStores. CONTEXT.md invariants 3, 7, 8, 9, 10 are enforced in services with explicit tests; no hard-deletes on payment records.

**Files changed (15):**
- WisPay/services/repositories.py (PaymentRecordStore Protocol + payments slot)
- WisPay/services/db.py (wispay_payment_record table + index in Azure SQL DDL)
- WisPay/services/sqlite_repositories.py (SqlitePaymentRecordStore)
- WisPay/services/sql_repositories.py (SqlPaymentRecordStore + parameter builder)
- WisPay/services/payment_recording.py (NEW: start_payment, record_payment with SoD guards)
- WisPay/services/audit_trail.py (InMemoryAuditTrail.append now accepts reason)
- scripts/sql/schema.sql + scripts/sql/schema.sqlite.sql (mirror new table)
- tests/services/test_db.py + test_db_sqlite.py (expected tables)
- tests/services/test_sqlite_repositories.py (PaymentRecordStore protocol check)
- tests/services/fakes.py (FakePaymentRecordStore)
- tests/services/test_payment_recording.py (NEW: 15 invariant tests)
- tests/services/test_service_wiring.py (NEW: 4 end-to-end integration tests)
- .scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md (§12 added)

**Verification:**
- WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///test.db + no Azure env → bash scripts/validate.sh → 222 passed, 9 deselected (e2e); ruff + mypy + format all pass.

Ready for the next task.

t5 (ST-1) complete. All `states/*` call into services through the `Stores` Protocol only — no `pyodbc`/`sqlite3` imports in any state file. `routers.py` is wired with hydration `on_load` hooks for every product surface plus a `WISPAY_DEMO_MODE=1` activation path that runs `seed_demo_state` once per process.

Verification: `bash scripts/validate.sh` → 246 passed, 9 deselected (e2e); ruff lint + format + mypy all green.

Deliverables:
- `WisPay/services/demo_seed.py` — S01–S16 covering all 14 LifecycleState values (Draft → Submitted → Budget → Compliance → Evidence → Approval Pending → Approved → Payment in Process → Paid → Closed → Adjustment Process, plus Returned / Rejected / Cancelled). Honors invariants 7, 8, 9, 10. Idempotent (clears prior `WPR-2026-DEMO-*` rows).
- 10 new state adapters: persona, dashboard, requests, finance_review, payments, admin, audit, reports, notifications, i18n.
- `RequestStore.list_all` added to the Protocol, both store implementations, and `FakeRequestStore`.
- Routers hydration hooks + demo seed activation.
- New tests: `test_demo_seed.py` (13), `test_new_states.py` (6), `test_routers.py` (4).
- Tracker §13 added with the change list + invariant mapping.

Ready to start t6 once the scheduler assigns me — until then I'm idle.
